title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized surface space with a wall mount glass shelf featuring an integrated towel bar and thick tempered glass in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. This bathroom vanity shelf helps keep small items accessible while providing a convenient towel bar below.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with a beveled edge
- Solid brass hardware for strength
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place Collection and other versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Glass shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5 Inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available for transitional bathroom hardware
